import re


def slugify(title: str) -> str:
    return re.sub(r'\s+', '-', title.lower())
E
cat >> tests/test_slug.py <<'E'


def test_slugify_single_space_becomes_one_hyphen():
    assert slugify('a b') == 'a-b'


def test_slugify_collapses_long_run():
    assert slugify('a     b') == 'a-b'


def test_slugify_collapses_tabs_newlines_and_mixed_whitespace():
    assert slugify('a\t\tb') == 'a-b'
    assert slugify('a\n\nb') == 'a-b'
    assert slugify('a \t\n b') == 'a-b'


def test_slugify_collapses_runs_at_ends():
    assert slugify('  a') == '-a'
    assert slugify('a  ') == 'a-'


def test_slugify_collapses_each_run_separately():
    assert slugify('a  b   c') == 'a-b-c'


def test_slugify_lowercases_with_whitespace_runs():
    assert slugify('Hello  World') == 'hello-world'
E
